description_for_human: Browse services, professionals, and availability for this business, and get a pre-filled booking link to confirm in your browser.
description_for_model: Plugin for browsing appointment booking data (services, availability) for a RENDEZVOUS tenant business and handing the end user a pre-filled booking link. This plugin is read-only: it does NOT create bookings directly. To book, direct the user to the returned deep link (e.g. https://{tenant-domain}/?service_ids={id}&worker_id={id}) so they can confirm details, log in, and pay in the human-facing UI.
